hooks.command: path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); echo "$path" | grep -qE '\.(env|secret|key)' && echo 'Blocked: cannot edit sensitive files' && exit 2 || exit 0
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git commit.*--no-verify|rm -rf /|DROP TABLE|git push --force|git reset --hard' && echo 'Blocked: dangerous command' && exit 2 || exit 0
path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); echo "$path" | grep -qE '\.py$' && ruff format --quiet "$path" && ruff check --fix --quiet "$path" 2>/dev/null || true

path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); echo "$path" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' || exit 0; cd "$(dirname "$path")"; while [ ! -f package.json ] && [ "$PWD" != / ]; do cd ..; done; npx eslint --fix --quiet "$path" 2>/dev/null || true
